CREATE VIEW vw_ultima_observacao AS
SELECT o.* FROM observacoes o
WHERE o.data_ref = (SELECT MAX(p.data_ref) FROM observacoes p
                   WHERE p.codigo_serie=o.codigo_serie)

arguments.sql: WITH RECURSIVE calendario(data_ref) AS (SELECT '2022-01-01' UNION ALL SELECT date(data_ref,'+1 month') FROM calendario WHERE data_ref < '2025-12-01'), codigos(codigo_serie) AS (SELECT 'BCB_433' UNION ALL SELECT 'BCB_189' UNION ALL SELECT 'IBGE_PMC' UNION ALL SELECT 'BCB_24364'), produto(codigo_serie,data_ref,fator,n) AS (SELECT codigo_serie,data_ref,1+valor/100.0,1 FROM observacoes WHERE codigo_serie IN ('BCB_433','BCB_189') AND data_ref='2025-01-01' UNION ALL SELECT o.codigo_serie,o.data_ref,p.fator*(1+o.valor/100.0),p.n+1 FROM produto p JOIN observacoes o ON o.codigo_serie=p.codigo_serie AND o.data_ref=date(p.data_ref,'+1 month') WHERE p.n<12) SELECT c.codigo_serie, COUNT(o.data_ref) AS observacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN o.data_ref IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS meses_ausentes, MIN(o.data_ref) AS inicio, MAX(o.data_ref) AS fim, (SELECT 100*(p.fator-1) FROM produto p WHERE p.codigo_serie=c.codigo_serie AND p.n=12) AS acumulado_12m_independente_2025 FROM codigos c CROSS JOIN calendario cal LEFT JOIN observacoes o ON o.codigo_serie=c.codigo_serie AND o.data_ref=cal.data_ref GROUP BY c.codigo_serie
